notes: Saved cards always open, even when their scans were moved or deleted: you see the saved grade, prices and notes, and can pick the scans again.
Add a card to My collection without scanning it: find it by name, say if it's raw or in a graded slab and what you paid. It gets prices, the price trend and keep-or-sell advice.
Chinese cards (traditional and simplified) are recognized and shown with their English name.
Opening a card whose scans are gone no longer gets stuck on Reading its scans.
